compiler_inputs: trusted workflow files on owning repository main
compiler_global_invariants: every route references exactly one existing runner class in the same project
every runner class has a unique scale_set_name, runner_prefix and controller Unix user across the fleet
every trusted workflow path is unique to one registered route unless an explicit multi-route workflow schema is introduced later
every registered trusted workflow has exactly one top-level job and that job targets the route's runner-class scale set
trusted workflow blob pin equals the file blob on the declared default branch at compilation checkpoint
the runner class execution contract and exact model/runtime bindings resolve to one deterministic root launch envelope
a runner_class_id is immutable with respect to its root launch envelope; semantic change requires a new class ID
executor ingress parameter schemas cannot select or widen runner class authority
root projection contains no slash commands, candidate SHA, PR number, workflow display name or experiment selector
controller projection contains no root resource selector supplied by GitHub/job input
executor projection contains no root resource ceiling, model mount path, GPU UUID or privileged launch detail

fields: execution_contract_id and fully resolved immutable contract
project runner UID/group and filesystem roots
forbidden_fields: workflow route ID as runtime selector
root.request_authority: SO_PEERCRED UID selects exactly one generated class record

fields: parameter schema ID and typed enum/range constraints
executor.rule: builder either emits a schema-valid ingress command or fails locally before GitHub mutation

migration_rule: generate and verify all projections repository-only; live reconciliation installs one catalog generation atomically after all current nonterminal class requests are drained or explicitly bound to the previous generation
